class.name: OcgTdocstdDocument
class.brief_description: The contents of a TDocStd_Application, a document is a container for a data framework composed of labels and attributes. As such, TDocStd_Document is the entry point into the data framework. To gain access to the data, you create a document as follows: Handle(TDocStd_Document) MyDF = new TDocStd_Document The document also allows you to manage: - modifications, providing Undo and Redo functions. - command transactions. Warning: The only data saved is the framework (TDF_Data)
class.description: ! The contents of a TDocStd_Application, a ! document is a container for a data framework ! composed of labels and attributes. As such, ! TDocStd_Document is the entry point into the data framework. ! To gain access to the data, you create a document as follows: ! Handle(TDocStd_Document) MyDF = new TDocStd_Document ! The document also allows you to manage: ! - modifications, providing Undo and Redo functions. ! - command transactions. ! Warning: The only data saved is the framework (TDF_Data)

method.name: IsSaved
method.description: the document is saved in a file.

method.name: IsChanged
method.description: returns True if document differs from the state of last saving. this method have to be called only working in the transaction mode

method.name: SetSaved
method.description: This method have to be called to show document that it has been saved

method.name: SetSavedTime
method.description: Say to document what it is not saved. Use value, returned earlier by GetSavedTime().

method.name: GetSavedTime
method.description: Returns value of <mySavedTime> to be used later in SetSavedTime()

method.name: Main
method.description: Returns the main label in this data framework. By definition, this is the label with the entry 0:1.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns True if the main label has no attributes

method.name: IsValid
method.description: Returns False if the document has been modified but not recomputed.

method.name: SetModified
method.description: Notify the label as modified, the Document becomes UnValid. returns True if <L> has been notified as modified.

method.name: PurgeModified
method.description: Remove all modifications. After this call The document becomesagain Valid.

method.name: NewCommand
method.description: Launches a new command. This command may be undone.

method.name: HasOpenCommand
method.description: returns True if a Command transaction is open in the current .

method.name: OpenCommand
method.description: Opens a new command transaction in this document. You can use HasOpenCommand to see whether a command is already open. Exceptions Standard_DomainError if a command is already open in this document.

method.name: CommitCommand
method.description: Commits documents transactions and fills the transaction manager with documents that have been changed during the transaction. If no command transaction is open, nothing is done. Returns True if a new delta has been added to myUndos.

method.name: AbortCommand
method.description: Abort the Command transaction. Does nothing If there is no Command transaction open.

method.name: GetUndoLimit
method.description: The current limit on the number of undos

method.name: SetUndoLimit
method.description: Set the limit on the number of Undo Delta stored 0 will disable Undo on the document A negative value means no limit. Note that by default Undo is disabled. Enabling it will take effect with the next call to NewCommand. Of course this limit is the same for Redo

method.name: ClearUndos
method.description: Remove all stored Undos and Redos

method.name: ClearRedos
method.description: Remove all stored Redos

method.name: GetAvailableUndos
method.description: Returns the number of undos stored in this document. If this figure is greater than 0, the method Undo can be used.

method.name: Undo
method.description: Will UNDO one step, returns False if no undo was done (Undos == 0). Otherwise, true is returned and one step in the list of undoes is undone.

method.name: GetAvailableRedos
method.description: Returns the number of redos stored in this document. If this figure is greater than 0, the method Redo can be used.

method.name: Redo
method.description: Will REDO one step, returns False if no redo was done (Redos == 0). Otherwise, true is returned, and one step in the list of redoes is done again.

method.name: RemoveFirstUndo
method.description: Removes the first undo in the list of document undos. It is used in the application when the undo limit is exceed.

method.name: InitDeltaCompaction
method.description: Initializes the procedure of delta compaction Returns false if there is no delta to compact Marks the last delta as a "from" delta

method.name: PerformDeltaCompaction
method.description: Performs the procedure of delta compaction Makes all deltas starting from "from" delta till the last one to be one delta.

method.name: Recompute
method.description: Recompute if the document was not valid and propagate the recorded modification.

method.name: SetEmptyLabelsSavingMode
method.description: Sets saving mode for empty labels. If Standard_True, empty labels will be saved.

method.name: EmptyLabelsSavingMode
method.description: Returns saving mode for empty labels.

method.name: SetNestedTransactionMode
method.description: Sets nested transaction mode if isAllowed == Standard_True

method.name: IsNestedTransactionMode
method.description: Returns Standard_True if mode is set

method.name: SetModificationMode
method.description: if theTransactionOnly is True changes is denied outside transactions

method.name: ModificationMode
method.description: returns True if changes allowed only inside transactions

method.name: BeforeClose
method.description: Prepares document for closing

method.name: StorageFormatVersion
method.description: Returns version of the format to be used to store the document

method.name: ChangeStorageFormatVersion
method.description: Sets version of the format to be used to store the document

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Get
method.description: Will Abort any execution, clear fields returns the document which contains <L>. raises an exception if the document is not found.

method.name: CurrentStorageFormatVersion
method.description: Returns current storage format version of the document.
